_comment: Single source of truth for the software apps shipped by this monorepo. Consumed by scripts/build_site.py (GitHub Pages landing page + deploy copy list) and scripts/publish_portfolio.py (portfolio cards + Obsidian notes). `description` is the full portfolio-card copy (HTML-ready); `desc` is the short landing-page blurb. `links` are relative to the deployed site root (https://juwpegatron.github.io/projects/<rel>). Extra fields `image_alt`, `project_id`, `label` (thumbnail aria-label) and `desc` reproduce the live markup verbatim.

apps.name: Orbis
apps.desc: Communication, identity and protection in one app
apps.description: Communication, identity, and protection in one app: a zero-dependency Python backend + SQLite + static PWA for managing replies, commitments, summaries, and personal growth tracking. Offline-first.

apps.name: Peers

apps.description: Offline-first single-file PWA for verified reviews across 32 category “modes” — food, travel, market, AI tools, health, finance and more. Pick a category and the feed, explore, market and writing all scope to it, with a Use it / Wait / Skip scorecard built in.

apps.name: Hazel
apps.desc: Desktop studio for creators — generate a video from a prompt, refine it, fan it out to every platform, and keep your storage from overfilling
apps.description: Desktop studio for creators. Generate a video from a prompt — cast the characters, choose a talking or drama scene, set the length and size — then refine it in Hazel's built-in editor and deploy to every platform at once. Also bulk-uploads photos and videos to socials, and backs up and auto-manages memories so your storage never overfills.
apps.image_alt: Hazel studio generating a video from a prompt, with character casting, scene choice, length and size controls, a storyboard and a timeline

apps.name: Sweep
apps.desc: Turn a plain-words idea into a checkable Build → Grow → Earn plan — then chat with Otto, an offline, approval-first AI operator (brand, site, posts, outreach, research, deck, insights, sheets) built to beat hosted builders on privacy and ownership
apps.description: Turn a rough app idea into a checkable Build → Grow → Earn plan — all local, offline and deterministic. A guided intake drafts your brief from plain words (no AI, no network); Sweep generates a capability matrix, a Definition of Done, a phased roadmap, Grow and Earn checklists, verification gates and a scaffold generator. Then run its built-in Operator (Otto) — a local, deterministic agent you actually chat with, organised into Overview / Create / Grow / Money / Data tabs. Otto drafts your brand kit (logo, palette, type), a one-page site, per-network posts with generated art, emails, customer outreach, a market-research brief, a pitch deck, a content calendar, a unified inbox, multi-sheet sales / stock / cost ledgers with an insights view and a plans table — all routed through an approval queue with a run log, undo, a credits meter and an autopilot toggle. Offline, encrypted at rest, fully exportable — you own everything, with no fee and no credit meter.
apps.image_alt: Sweep turning a plain-words idea into a Build, Grow and Earn plan — a guided intake, an idea brief, a generated capability matrix, a Definition of Done checklist, a scaffold file tree and a project catalog

apps.name: Virtual Bots
apps.desc: An office of AI bots you can watch and command — live activity, goals and progress across App, Web and Mobile
apps.description: An office of AI bots you can watch and command — each bot shows its role, live status and progress; a normalized activity feed streams every tool step, and you can dispatch new goals. Ships as an installable App, a desktop Web dashboard (with a 3D office) and a Mobile view; it runs as an offline simulation when no backend is attached.
apps.image_alt: Virtual Bots Office dashboard: AI bots at their desks with live status, an activity feed and a command bar

apps.name: Airiz Motor
apps.desc: Dependency-free browser console for AIRIZ motor testing — command library, serial console and macro notepad
apps.description: A dependency-free browser console that replaces the TeraTerm/CWD serial workflow for AIRIZ device motor testing — browse a categorised command library with live parameters, drive a dark serial console with scrollback and log saving, build and run test macros in a visual notepad, install it as an offline PWA, and try the whole UI in a hardware-free demo mode.
apps.image_alt: Airiz Motor Test Console dashboard: command library, serial console and macro notepad for AIRIZ device motor testing

apps.name: Vertex
apps.desc: One local 3D app — build parts and export 3D files (STL/OBJ/glTF/3MF/DXF), repair models and plan assemblies in ANY 3D software, ask design questions, reverse-engineer scans, turn drawings into CAD, automate batches, and simulate
apps.description: Vertex is one local, offline, zero-dependency 3D app that unifies a parametric part builder with a universal 3D engineering copilot. Build geometry from parameters/primitives and export real 3D files (STL ascii+binary, OBJ, glTF 2.0, 3MF, DXF); read a host-agnostic ModelReport and get a typed Diagnosis of what is broken (failed fillets, broken references, dangling or circular dependencies, failed mates) with an ordered upstream-first Repair plan and an Assembly plan (base part + insert/mate steps + structural checks); ask questions about the design and get deterministic Answers with evidence (failed features, dependencies, mates, how-to); reverse-engineer a point scan into editable parametric CAD; turn a drawing spec into a model; run batch Automation (export / pattern / drawing sheets); and run deterministic simulations (kinematic assembly motion, mass properties, clearance/interference). A universal adapter layer covers Fusion, SOLIDWORKS, FreeCAD, Blender, Onshape, Rhino, SketchUp, Inventor, AutoCAD, CATIA, Solid Edge, Creo, Maya and open formats STEP/STL/OBJ/glTF/3MF/DXF. The geometry core is a pure function (identical input yields byte-identical output); every action passes a dry-run and review gate; with no CAD host attached it runs in a fully usable simulation mode and never writes to CAD. It complements cloud AI CAD copilots (like Vector) by staying local, open, deterministic, auditable and review-gated.
apps.image_alt: Vertex: a dark 3D engineering workspace with a fitted part in a viewport, a ranked repair plan, a universal adapter strip (Fusion, SOLIDWORKS, FreeCAD, Blender, open formats) and review-gated export/apply steps

apps.name: SOMA
apps.desc: Open-source AI CAD — describe a part, your coding agent writes CadQuery, SOMA builds it
apps.description: SOMA is an open-source desktop CAD app where a coding agent does the CAD — you describe the part, the agent writes it as CadQuery Python, and SOMA rebuilds and shows the result on every change. Measure, mark up the view, tune parameters, step through history, run overhang and wall-thickness checks plus FEM analysis, then export STEP/STL/3MF/DXF with PDF drawings. Bring your own CLI agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI). By Kai Jungsthöfel. GPL-3.0. Windows / macOS / Linux.
apps.image_alt: SOMA: a CadQuery code panel beside a rebuilt parametric part and a build log

apps.name: Vector
apps.desc: Engineering copilot that works inside Autodesk Fusion and SOLIDWORKS
apps.description: Vector is an AI engineering copilot for real hardware that runs inside your existing CAD — Autodesk Fusion (macOS / Windows) and SOLIDWORKS (Windows). It reads the open document, answers questions about the design, creates and edits native features through the host application's own API, repairs broken models end to end (failed fillets, broken references, features that stop rebuilding), and shows every change for review before it lands in your feature tree. By Vector Copilot LLC.
apps.image_alt: Vector: connected Fusion and SOLIDWORKS integrations beside a chat panel showing a ranked repair plan

apps.name: Marina Bay Sands Miniature
apps.desc: Agentic-CAD tabletop miniature — three curved glass towers joined by the boat-shaped SkyPark
apps.description: A tabletop miniature of Marina Bay Sands, modelled as parametric CadQuery by an AI agent in SOMA. Three curved glass hotel towers — bowed bay-facing facade, slight taper — stand in a straight row and are joined on top by the boat-shaped SkyPark, whose long cantilever curls upward like a ship's bow past the last tower. About 250 mm tall, Z-up on the z=0 ground plane, and driven entirely by twelve live parameters (tower height, width, depth and gap; facade bow; taper; SkyPark width, thickness, cantilever, tip rise and far-end overhang). Every edit rebuilds deterministically and exports to STEP and glTF.
apps.image_alt: Marina Bay Sands miniature: three curved glass towers joined by the boat-shaped SkyPark with its upturned cantilever tip

apps.description: A compact 60 × 40 × 10 mm mounting bracket — a single watertight solid (2,044 triangles, 23.2 cm³, printable as-is) exported twice from the same geometry: STEP AP214 for CAD and binary STL for printing.

apps.name: Image-to-3D Chair
apps.desc: A tufted dining chair reconstructed from a single photo into a 3D mesh (TripoSR)
apps.description: An image-to-3D reconstruction: one product photo of a tufted cream-and-walnut side chair turned into a triangle mesh by TripoSR. The source photo and the resulting mesh are kept side by side so the whole pipeline stays reproducible.
apps.image_alt: Source photo of a tufted cream and walnut dining chair, reconstructed into a 3D mesh with TripoSR
